featured.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Surges Past 330 as Glacier Collapse Scale Becomes Clear
featured.excerpt: Scientists confirm an ice-rock avalanche, not an earthquake, triggered one of Nepal's worst natural disasters, with over 900 people still missing including dozens of Americans and 177 Indian pilgrims.
featured.image_caption: An aerial view shows houses buried under mud and debris following flash floods in Nepal on August 26, 2026. The floods killed over 330 people and left more than 900 missing across eight districts.
featured.nri_angle: 177 Indian pilgrims en route to Kailash Mansarovar are among the missing, 63 Americans unaccounted for, and downstream flooding prompted evacuations in Bihar — the disaster has direct implications for diaspora families across South Asia.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

editorial.title: Who Is Vishal Sikka? The AI Pioneer Who Ran Infosys — and Just Raised $85 Million to Disrupt It
editorial.excerpt: Nine years after a bruising exit from Infosys, the 59-year-old former SAP CTO has founded Hang Ten Systems, an enterprise AI startup that closed $85 million in seed funding in four months — with Intel and Micron's CEOs writing checks.
editorial.image_caption: Vishal Sikka speaking at SAP's SAPPHIRE conference in Orlando in 2010, when he was the company's first-ever CTO. In 2026 he founded Hang Ten Systems, an enterprise AI startup that has raised $85 million in seed funding.
editorial.nri_angle: Sikka's arc — small-town Madhya Pradesh to Stanford mentorship under AI's founding fathers to the top of Infosys and SAP, and now a founder again at 59 — embodies the Indian diaspora's outsize role in the AI era.
editorial.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Six Indian Films Head to Busan International Film Festival 2026
just_in.excerpt: From Rima Das's Not a Hero to Anuparna Roy's Venice-bound Lovers in the Blue Night, six Indian features screen at Asia's largest film festival from October 6 — with more titles in the Vision Asia and Wide Angle sections.
just_in.image_caption: Stills from Birds in the Dark (left) and Birds on Ice (right), two of the Indian films selected for the 31st Busan International Film Festival. The festival runs October 6 to 15 at the Busan Cinema Center in South Korea.
just_in.nri_angle: Festival selections are the early signal of what diaspora audiences will see on streaming months later — Busan screenings with English subtitles are also gathering points for Indian cinema lovers in South Korea's South Asian expatriate community.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India Clinch Sepaktakraw Bronze After Narrow Semifinal Loss to Japan
just_in.excerpt: India's men's quadrant team went down 0-2 to Japan in the sepaktakraw semifinal at Nagoya, securing the country's third Asian Games medal in the sport and its first in the quadrant event.
just_in.image_caption: Members of India's men's sepaktakraw quadrant squad pictured at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. India went down 0-2 to hosts Japan in the semifinal on October 2 to take bronze — the country's third sepaktakraw medal at the Asiad and its first in the quadrant event.
just_in.nri_angle: The bronze resonates with the Northeast Indian diaspora, whose communities champion sepaktakraw as a sport where their states lead the nation — a national podium finish validates that pride on Asia's biggest stage.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Mizoram's Anthurium Festival Returns After Three Years With Flowers, Culture, Adventure
just_in.excerpt: The October 1–3 event at Ailawng and Reiek blends flower shows, treks, cave exploration and Mizo heritage — and the state is pitching it as tourism that puts villages first.
just_in.image_caption: Performers in traditional Mizo dress do the Cheraw bamboo dance at the Anthurium Festival venue, the festival sign visible at left. The festival returned to Ailawng and Reiek villages in Mizoram Mamit district on October 1, 2026, after a three-year hiatus.
just_in.nri_angle: For the Mizo diaspora at home and abroad, the festival's return is a cultural homecoming signal — and its women-led anthurium export story gives diaspora travellers a point of pride and a reason to plan visits around it.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Adani Group Reaffirms Rs 6 Lakh Crore Investment Blueprint for Maharashtra
just_in.excerpt: Pranav Adani said projects worth Rs 2.6 lakh crore — over 43% of the blueprint — are already completed or under execution, as Maharashtra chases its $1 trillion economy target by 2030.
just_in.image_caption: Adani Enterprises director Pranav Adani, in a file photo. He announced the Adani Group's investment blueprint of over Rs 6 lakh crore for Maharashtra at the Invest Maharashtra launch in Mumbai, saying projects worth Rs 2.6 lakh crore are already completed or under execution.
just_in.nri_angle: NRI investors with Adani stock or India-fund exposure face concentrated exposure to one state's regulatory environment; global bondholders will watch whether the 43% execution pace sustains.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Manchester City Verdict Strains Britain's Diplomatic Ties With the UAE
just_in.excerpt: The UAE has warned London that sanctions against the Abu Dhabi-owned club could cool future investment, while British ministers privately question whether senior Emirati figures knew of the £900 million financial misconduct.
just_in.image_caption: Manchester City's Etihad Stadium in Manchester, with its distinctive cable-stayed roof masts visible. The Abu Dhabi-owned club was found guilty of 130 breaches of Premier League financial rules, a verdict now straining diplomatic ties between the UK and the UAE.
just_in.nri_angle: The UAE hosts one of the largest Indian communities in the world, and friction over London-Abu Dhabi investment flows matters to the diaspora in both countries.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: IIT Bombay Students Begin Hunger Strike, Demand Accountability in Sahil Wakode's Death
just_in.excerpt: Weeks after second-year student Sahil Wakode was found dead in his hostel room, students at IIT Bombay have begun a hunger strike demanding a credible investigation into allegations of caste-based harassment and a biased internal probe.
just_in.image_caption: Sahil Wakode's parents sit on a hunger strike holding his portrait, beneath a banner reading "Hunger Strike Day-4, Justice for Sahil". They allege he faced caste-based harassment at IIT Bombay and are demanding action against those named in the police complaint.
just_in.nri_angle: NRI families track IIT campus accountability closely; the case tests whether elite Indian institutions offer transparent probes and external oversight that diaspora parents expect.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: From Bachchan to Kher, Bollywood's Veterans Prove Fitness Has No Age Limit
just_in.excerpt: At 83, Amitabh Bachchan preaches caring for the body; at 88, Dharmendra mixes gym work with physiotherapy; at 70, Anupam Kher lifts heavy — Bollywood's senior stars are making strength after 70 look normal.
just_in.image_caption: Dharmendra poses in a gym wearing a workout shirt and cap. The 88-year-old actor shared the Instagram video to show fans his daily exercise and physiotherapy routine.
just_in.nri_angle: For NRIs watching aging parents from afar, these stars' public fitness routines offer a conversation starter and a cultural counterweight to the idea that slowing down after 60 is inevitable.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Rubio Orders Iran's Delegation Out of New York as Talks Stall
just_in.excerpt: U.S. officials say Iran's U.N. team had "overstayed their welcome" after indirect talks on the war and the Strait of Hormuz reached an impasse; Tehran insists the departure was pre-scheduled.
just_in.image_caption: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi speaks at the United Nations in New York. Secretary of State Marco Rubio ordered Iran's delegation to leave the city as nuclear talks stalled.
just_in.nri_angle: The Hormuz standoff affects oil prices tied to India's imports, and the Qatari mediation runs through Doha, home to one of the region's largest Indian expatriate communities.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India vs Pakistan Asian Games Final: Predicted XIs, Key Battles, Match Details
just_in.excerpt: India and Pakistan meet in the men's cricket gold medal match at the Asian Games 2026 on October 3 in Nisshin, Japan — with India favourites to retain the title after a 124-run semifinal rout of Sri Lanka.
just_in.image_caption: India captain Shreyas Iyer and Pakistan captain Sahibzada Farhan pictured ahead of the Asian Games 2026 cricket final. The two teams meet for gold on October 3 at Korogi Sports Park in Nisshin, Japan — the first India-Pakistan final in Asian Games history.
just_in.nri_angle: Diaspora fans in the US/Canada face a 1 AM ET start for the India-Pakistan gold medal match, with global SonyLIV streaming expected to draw millions of overseas viewers.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: 'Passportmaxxing': H-1B Uncertainty Pushes Indians in US Toward Second Residencies
just_in.excerpt: A Dubai-based citizenship advisory firm says it has processed 450+ Indian clients for second passports as green-card backlogs and tougher visa enforcement turn mobility into an asset class.
just_in.image_caption: Indian professionals in the US are increasingly buying second residencies and citizenships as a Plan B against H-1B and green-card uncertainty.
just_in.nri_angle: H-1B families are pricing the risk of employer-sponsored status and buying residency optionality — with the caveat that India bars dual citizenship.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Moneyview Shares End Market Debut 59% Above Issue Price
just_in.excerpt: The digital lender listed at Rs 55.6 on the BSE — a 64% premium to its Rs 34 IPO price — and closed its maiden session at Rs 54.03 with a Rs 9,510 crore market cap.
just_in.image_caption: An Inc42 illustration shows Moneyview's app and branding around its market debut. The digital lender's shares closed their first trading day at Rs 54.03, about 59% above the Rs 34 issue price.
just_in.nri_angle: Another data point in India's 2026 IPO boom for diaspora investors watching Indian fintech through mutual funds and fintech ETFs.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: US Mortgage Rates Post Biggest Weekly Jump in Four Years, Hit 7.28%
just_in.excerpt: Freddie Mac's weekly survey showed the average 30-year fixed rate surging to 7.28% on October 1, the highest since November 2023, as a Treasury sell-off rippled into housing.
just_in.image_caption: US mortgage rates posted their biggest weekly jump in four years, hitting 7.28% as the 10-year Treasury yield neared a quarter-century high.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian-American buyers in high-cost markets (Bay Area, Seattle, New Jersey) face roughly $313 more a month on a $500k loan than a year ago.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Sarvam AI's Saaras V4 Brings Speech Recognition to All 22 Indian Languages
just_in.excerpt: The Bengaluru startup's new speech-to-text model covers 22 Indian languages plus English from a single 3-billion-parameter system, and claims it beats much larger global models on Indian speech.
just_in.image_caption: A branded graphic for Saaras V4, Sarvam AI's new speech-to-text model. It covers all 22 scheduled Indian languages plus global English from a single 3-billion-parameter system.
just_in.nri_angle: Cheaper, India-built voice AI for the diaspora's India-facing businesses, and a home-grown benchmark for Indian engineers working on speech at US labs.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: EaseMyTrip Gives Hero Flydubai Pilot Free Domestic Flights for Five Years
just_in.excerpt: After Capt Smit Machchhar was stabbed by his co-pilot on Flydubai flight FZ1073 and helped save 170+ lives, EaseMyTrip announced free domestic travel for him, his wife and children for five years.
just_in.nri_angle: Thousands of Indian pilots fly for Gulf carriers, so the attack on Capt Machchhar in a flydubai cockpit on a Gulf–Tel Aviv route hits close to diaspora families in the UAE; his heroism has resonated globally as a story of composure saving 170+ lives.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Indian Startups Raise $397 Million Across 19 Deals in September's Strongest Funding Week
just_in.excerpt: DMI Finance's $152 million debt raise and Ampin Energy Transition's $100 million Series E headlined the September 21–26 week, with Ultraviolette and Ema closing the biggest equity rounds.
just_in.image_caption: Startup funding data illustration. Indian startups raised over $397 million across 19 deals in the week of September 21–26, 2026, led by DMI Finance's $152 million debt raise.
just_in.nri_angle: Diaspora investors and NRI angels allocating to India get a disciplined, sector-diverse week — foreign leads like Norfund, Yali and TDK Ventures show global capital riding the same rails.

news.title: Bangkok Struggles With Worst Flooding in 15 Years as Water Recedes
news.excerpt: Some 320 mm of rain in two to three days left waist-deep water across the capital, killed at least eight nationwide, stranded Thai Airways passengers, and could shave 0.3 points off GDP growth.
news.nri_angle: Bangkok is a major destination for Indian travellers; New Delhi flights were cancelled and baggage chaos at Suvarnabhumi hit Indian passengers hardest, while Bangkok's Indian trading community sits in the wholesale districts expected to take the heaviest economic hit.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: NASA Chief Warns China Could Shut U.S. Out of Lunar South Pole
news.excerpt: Administrator Jared Isaacman said China's delayed Chang'e 7 mission targeted the same Shackleton Crater the U.S. wants, and safety exclusion zones could lock American missions out of the water-ice-rich terrain.
news.nri_angle: India is an Artemis Accords signatory and Indian media reported NASA invited ISRO into the moon base program, placing India's space agency among the partners defining lunar norms.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: From Security Guard to Rs 50 Lakh a Month: Assam Man's Frozen Paratha Triumph
news.excerpt: Diganta Das of Gohpur, Assam, went from earning Rs 1,200 a month as a construction labourer to running a frozen Malabar parotta brand that produces over 20,000 parottas a day.
news.image_caption: Diganta Das’s DFF brand produces more than 20,000 frozen Malabar parottas a day.
news.nri_angle: Das's rise from migrant worker to food entrepreneur mirrors the journey of many diaspora families who built businesses from a single trade, and his frozen Malabar parottas sit in one of the fastest-growing diaspora grocery segments.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Nearly 1.9 Lakh Cancer Cases in India Tied to Infections, Lancet Study Finds
news.excerpt: A Lancet study estimates infections caused nearly 1.9 lakh of India's new cancer cases in 2024, led by HPV-linked cervical cancer, highlighting the role of vaccination and screening in prevention.
news.image_caption: Researchers study infection-linked cancers in a laboratory
news.nri_angle: For the diaspora, the study is a reminder that cancer-prevention norms differ by geography: many countries offer HPV vaccination to adolescents and routine HPV screening to adult women as standard care, and NRIs traveling with or caring for family in India can help close the gap by encouraging both.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Putin Says PM Modi Has 'Very Good Ideas' for Ending Ukraine Conflict
news.excerpt: The Russian president, speaking at the Valdai International Discussion Club, said Modi raises the issue of ending the war at every meeting and that Moscow is thankful for India's push for a peaceful settlement.
news.image_caption: Russian President Vladimir Putin shakes hands with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, both smiling, at a recent meeting. Putin praised Modi's "very good ideas" for a mutually acceptable settlement of the Ukraine conflict at the Valdai International Discussion Club on October 1.
news.nri_angle: The diaspora has watched India's balancing act since 2022 — from student evacuations in Ukraine to energy-price ripples — and Putin's public praise will be read as validation of India's growing diplomatic weight.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Journalist Among Eight Palestinians Killed in Israeli Attacks on Gaza
news.excerpt: Palestinian journalist Muhammad Abdel Aziz al-Najjar, the 263rd media worker killed since October 2023, died as Israeli strikes hit a Gaza City van, an apartment, and a displaced-persons shelter amid continued ceasefire violations.
news.image_caption: A dusty street in Deir el-Balah in the Gaza Strip after Israeli bombing, August 2024. A journalist was among eight Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza.
news.nri_angle: India's large media community and diaspora follow Gaza's journalist death toll closely; Indian press-freedom advocates have demanded international accountability for the killing of media workers.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Tech Mahindra and Infinite Uptime Partner to Scale Physical AI in Manufacturing
nri-world.excerpt: The deal pairs Infinite Uptime's PlantOS™ prescriptive-intelligence platform with Tech Mahindra's global IT-OT transformation capabilities, targeting steel, cement, chemicals, and mining — first in North America and Europe.
nri-world.nri_angle: A Pune deep-tech startup scaling worldwide via an Indian IT services giant, with Indian engineers in North American and European manufacturing plants among the first to encounter the joint offering — a marker of Indian IT climbing the AI value chain.

nri-world.title: Civil engineer earns Rs 35 lakh from four acres of red bananas
nri-world.excerpt: Abhijeet Patil of Maharashtra skipped the engineering job queue in 2015, planted red bananas in 2020, and sold 60 tonnes through Reliance and Tata outlets in three metros.
nri-world.image_caption: Red bananas fetch Rs 60–90 per kg, several times the price of the common yellow variety.
nri-world.nri_angle: NRIs investing in Indian farmland get a template: premium horticulture with organized-retail linkages beats commodity crops, and professional skills transfer to farming.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: After 20 Miscarriages Over a Decade, Chicago Mom Celebrates Son's First Birthday
nri-world.excerpt: Ranim Haddad, 36, of Alsip, Illinois, endured at least 20 pregnancy losses with husband Fuad before conceiving naturally in 2020 — and marked the milestone on October 1, the start of Pregnancy and Infant Loss Awareness Month.
nri-world.image_caption: A mother holds her newborn; a Chicago mom is celebrating her son's milestone after a decade-long fertility journey
nri-world.nri_angle: Recurrent pregnancy loss is a subject many South Asian families also face in silence, where cultural pressure around having children can make fertility struggles especially isolating — the Haddads' openness gives other families permission to name their own losses.
tags: Pregnancy and Infant Loss Awareness Month
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: California Bans AI-Only Firing of Workers With Landmark No Robo Bosses Act
immigration.excerpt: Governor Gavin Newsom signed SB 947 on September 30, making California the first state to require a human to corroborate any termination or discipline decision driven primarily by AI — reversing his veto of a similar bill last year.
immigration.nri_angle: California's large Indian diaspora tech workforce gains a concrete safeguard against opaque automated firing and discipline decisions.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.nri_angle: The Jio Platforms listing gives NRI investors a rare direct entry into India's digital story, with Meta and Google as backers and a $137 billion valuation as the global benchmark.

markets-finance.title: Middle East Oil Exports Rebound to Near Pre-War Levels as Crude Prices Stay Volatile
markets-finance.excerpt: Crude flows from the Gulf have recovered to about 98% of pre-war levels through overland pipelines and ship-to-ship transfers, but Brent prices remain volatile near $97–102 as tanker attacks continue and the U.S. sends a third carrier group to the region.
markets-finance.image_caption: An illustration shows oil barrels and a pump jack at sunset. Crude exports from the Gulf have rebounded to about 98% of pre-war levels through overland pipelines and ship-to-ship transfers, though Brent prices remain volatile near $97-102 a barrel as tanker attacks continue.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The Gulf's crude matters directly to India, which imports the bulk of its oil from the region: a sustained export recovery would ease India's import bill and take pressure off fuel prices and the rupee, while any renewed disruption hits Indian households and the government's finances first.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Nike Stock Plunges 8.5% After Revenue Miss, Steep Forecast Cut and Job-Cut Plan
markets-finance.excerpt: Nike reported $11.21 billion in quarterly revenue, below Wall Street estimates, and warned full-year revenue will decline by a high single-digit percentage — unveiling a 'Pace' restructuring with job cuts and a new India campus.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Nike swoosh logo displayed at a company store. Nike shares fell 8.5% in extended trading after the company missed revenue estimates and warned full-year revenue would decline by a high single-digit percentage.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Nike's planned new India campus — framed as offering "strong capabilities and access to talent" — positions India as the brand's next hub for design, engineering and supply-chain talent even as it cuts roles elsewhere.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Fed's Jefferson Flags High Inflation, Urges Patience on October Rate Decision
markets-finance.excerpt: In a Thursday speech at the University of Virginia, Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson said inflation has run above the 2% target for more than five years, even as he signaled officials may hold rates at the October 27–28 meeting to assess incoming data.
markets-finance.image_caption: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson
markets-finance.nri_angle: A Fed hold is practical news for Indian diaspora households in the United States: it takes pressure off mortgage rates and dollar savings, while investors with stakes in Indian equities and the rupee benefit from less capital-flight pressure each time a U.S. hike is deferred.

sports.excerpt: The ICC has released the 2027 men's ODI World Cup schedule, with Johannesburg's Wanderers hosting both the India–Pakistan clash on October 10 and the final on November 21, and an official ticket ballot now open.
sports.image_caption: The Wanderers Stadium in Johannesburg, set to host the 2027 World Cup final
sports.nri_angle: The ICC's official ticket ballot, open from October 1 until November 21, gives diaspora fans in North America, the UK and the Gulf a fair, non-first-come-first-served shot at seats for the India–Pakistan game and the final at the Wanderers.

sports.title: Lovlina Borgohain Wins Gold on Her Birthday as India Powers Through Day 14
sports.excerpt: On her 29th birthday, Lovlina Borgohain beat China's Bao Ziyi 5-0 to win 75kg boxing gold at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games — while India's women's recurve team stunned South Korea for a historic first gold and Sujeet Kalkal reached the 65kg wrestling final.
sports.image_caption: Lovlina Borgohain celebrates after winning the women's 75kg boxing gold at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on October 2, 2026. The 29-year-old defeated China's Bao Ziyi 5-0 on her birthday, becoming only the second Indian woman after Mary Kom to win Asian Games boxing gold.
sports.nri_angle: Lovlina's birthday gold and the teenage heroics of Kumkum Mohod will resonate with diaspora audiences, who consistently engage most strongly with these landmark Indian sporting moments.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Indian IT Shift: Routine Jobs Face AI Pressure, Specialist Skills in Demand
technology.excerpt: Large-scale layoffs are behind Indian IT, recruiters say, but targeted exits and selective backfilling are reshaping hiring — with AI fluency now the decisive dividing line.
technology.nri_angle: NRI tech professionals face the same AI-driven restructuring seen in Indian IT; the premium accrues to engineers who can orchestrate AI systems rather than perform tasks within them.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: TakeMe2Space to Launch India's First Orbital Computing Satellite on SpaceX Rocket
technology.excerpt: Hyderabad startup TakeMe2Space's sub-50 kg MOI-1A satellite, carrying Nvidia Orin NX edge processors, flies on SpaceX's Transporter-18 mission on October 1 with 23 customers signed.
technology.image_caption: TakeMe2Space's sub-50 kg MOI-1A satellite carries Nvidia Orin NX edge-computing processors and a 9-band multispectral imager. It is scheduled to launch on SpaceX's Transporter-18 rideshare mission on October 1.
technology.nri_angle: With US firms already signed as customers and Indian-origin engineers prominent in global space-tech, TakeMe2Space's orbital-compute bet gives diaspora professionals a new India-built capability to watch.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Six Indian Films Head to Busan International Film Festival 2026
entertainment.excerpt: From Rima Das's Not a Hero to Anuparna Roy's Venice-bound Lovers in the Blue Night, six Indian features screen at Asia's largest film festival from October 6 — with more titles in the Vision Asia and Wide Angle sections.
entertainment.image_caption: Stills from Birds in the Dark (left) and Birds on Ice (right), two of the Indian films selected for the 31st Busan International Film Festival. The festival runs October 6 to 15 at the Busan Cinema Center in South Korea.
entertainment.nri_angle: Festival selections are the early signal of what diaspora audiences will see on streaming months later — Busan screenings with English subtitles are also gathering points for Indian cinema lovers in South Korea's South Asian expatriate community.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: The Vvaan Crosses Rs 50 Crore in Week One Despite Drishyam 3 Arriving
entertainment.excerpt: Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah's fantasy thriller crossed Rs 50 crore net in India in its first week, with Rs 69.07 crore worldwide — just as Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3 opened to challenge it.
entertainment.image_caption: Sidharth Malhotra stars in the fantasy thriller The Vvaan, which crossed Rs 50 crore net in its first week.
entertainment.nri_angle: The Vvaan's overseas gross of Rs 5.5 crore and its mass-circuit acceptance matter to diaspora audiences whose ticket purchases increasingly decide the fate of mid-budget Hindi originals like this Sidharth-Tamannaah fantasy thriller.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: CBFC Clears Drishyam The Conclusion With Zero Cuts; 150-Minute Runtime Confirmed
entertainment.excerpt: The CBFC passed the Ajay Devgn thriller with a U/A 16+ certificate on September 28 — no cuts, no modifications — setting up the 150-minute finale for its October 2 release.
entertainment.image_caption: Ajay Devgn returns as Vijay Salgaonkar in Drishyam The Conclusion, the final instalment of the Hindi crime-thriller franchise. The CBFC cleared the 150-minute film with a U/A 16+ certificate and zero cuts ahead of its October 2 release.
entertainment.nri_angle: The Drishyam franchise has a strong NRI following thanks to its Malayalam roots and family-thriller formula; The Conclusion opens overseas via Panorama Studios and Zee Studios on October 2.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Part 1 Is Now Titled 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend'
entertainment.excerpt: Sony Pictures announced the official title on September 28 with a new poster, confirming a worldwide IMAX 3D release on November 6, 2026, in Hindi and English under the tagline "Mankind's greatest story comes to life."
entertainment.image_caption: The official poster for "Ramayana: Rise of a Legend" shows Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama holding a bow opposite Yash's Ravana against a cosmic backdrop. Sony Pictures announced the title and a worldwide IMAX 3D release on November 6, 2026, under the tagline "Mankind's greatest story comes to life."
entertainment.nri_angle: The film is explicitly engineered for a global audience — English version, worldwide IMAX rollout, Sony's international distribution — putting diaspora audiences in Los Angeles, London, Toronto and Sydney at the center of its release plan.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Drishyam 3 Sells 4.05 Lakh Tickets in Advance, 7th-Biggest Pre-Sale Ever
entertainment.excerpt: Ajay Devgn's Drishyam: The Conclusion has sold around 4.05 lakh opening-day tickets in PVR Inox and Cinepolis, ranking 7th all-time and second in 2026, with trade forecasting a Rs. 50 crore opening on Gandhi Jayanti.
entertainment.image_caption: Official poster artwork for Drishyam: The Conclusion, featuring Ajay Devgn (center) and Tabu (right). The film sold around 4.05 lakh opening-day tickets across PVR Inox and Cinepolis, the 7th-biggest advance sale in Bollywood history, ahead of its October 2 release.
entertainment.nri_angle: The Drishyam franchise has always traveled well with the Indian diaspora, and overseas screens in North America, the UK and the Middle East open alongside the Indian release, giving diaspora audiences a record-breaking reason to catch the finale in theaters.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: MrBeast's Ramayana Appearance Puts Spotlight on His $200,000 Event Fee
entertainment.excerpt: The world's most-subscribed YouTuber joined Ranbir Kapoor and the 'Ramayana: Part 1' team at a Mumbai event on September 26 — the same night a new collaboration between MrBeast and producer Namit Malhotra was revealed.
entertainment.image_caption: YouTuber MrBeast (Jimmy Donaldson) poses in a black jacket against a promotional backdrop. The world's most-subscribed YouTuber attended a September 26 "Ramayana: Part 1" event in Mumbai alongside Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and the film's team.
entertainment.nri_angle: The Indian epic is being marketed to a global audience — including the diaspora — and the world's biggest YouTuber chanting 'Jai Shree Ram' shows how far Indian popular culture has travelled.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Gastroenterologist Explains Six Everyday Habits That Cause Bloating After Meals
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Eating too fast, oversized dinners, hidden constipation and poor sleep — Dr Vineet K Gupta says recurring bloating is usually about repeated daily behaviours, not a single bad food.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asian diaspora households eat late, large, lentil-and-bean-heavy dinners — the exact pattern Dr Gupta flags — making his slow-down, track-patterns advice a low-cost starting point before supplements or elimination diets.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: From Bachchan to Kher, Bollywood's Veterans Prove Fitness Has No Age Limit
lifestyle-health.excerpt: At 83, Amitabh Bachchan preaches caring for the body; at 88, Dharmendra mixes gym work with physiotherapy; at 70, Anupam Kher lifts heavy — Bollywood's senior stars are making strength after 70 look normal.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Dharmendra poses in a gym wearing a workout shirt and cap. The 88-year-old actor shared the Instagram video to show fans his daily exercise and physiotherapy routine.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: For NRIs watching aging parents from afar, these stars' public fitness routines offer a conversation starter and a cultural counterweight to the idea that slowing down after 60 is inevitable.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Quitting ultra-processed food may ease depression, small UCSF study finds
lifestyle-health.excerpt: In a first-of-its-kind 20-person crossover trial published in JAMA Psychiatry, participants who cut ultra-processed food by 85% saw moderate-to-large improvements in depression symptoms.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asian diaspora households juggling convenience food get one more evidence point favoring traditional minimally processed home cooking, though the study is preliminary and not medical advice.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: One in Three Indian Employees in Their 30s Has Elevated Blood Sugar
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Loop Health's Workforce Health Index 2026, built on 816,000+ lab values, found blood-sugar dysfunction rising from 16.7% in employees' 20s to 52.9% in their 40s — with most people unaware anything is wrong.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A blood glucose meter used to test blood sugar levels
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians face elevated diabetes risk at lower body weights, so an annual HbA1c check in the 30s is a sensible baseline — and diaspora readers can nudge family in India in precisely the urban-workforce cohort this report covers.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Indore Clinic Launches Madhya Pradesh's First Alzheimer's Blood Biomarker Test
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Sampurna Sodani Diagnostic Clinic in Indore says its new pTau217 and Aβ42 blood test can flag Alzheimer's-related brain changes 10 to 15 years before symptoms, offering a less invasive alternative to spinal taps and PET scans.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: An illustration depicts an elderly man with a puzzle-piece brain graphic labeled Alzheimer's Disease. Sampurna Sodani Diagnostic Clinic in Indore says its new pTau217 and A-beta-42 blood biomarker test can flag Alzheimer's-related brain changes 10 to 15 years before symptoms appear.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: For diaspora families with aging parents in India, the test adds a concrete option for elder-care planning back home: a blood-based screening in a tier-2 city can give NRIs coordinating care from abroad an earlier, clearer picture of a parent's cognitive health without requiring travel to a metro hospital.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Vaping Harms the Heart Too, Not Just the Lungs, Doctors Warn
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Growing research shows e-cigarettes expose users to chemicals that damage blood vessels and disrupt heart rhythm — and a new expert consensus says no nicotine product is safe for the heart.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: An electronic cigarette; doctors warn vaping harms the heart as well as the lungs
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Vaping remains widely available to young people despite India's 2019 ban, and diaspora families in the US and UK face aggressive youth marketing of flavored vapes — doctors advise parents to treat vaping as a genuine cardiovascular risk, not a phase.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Beyond the Espresso: How India's Cafés Are Winning Customer Loyalty
food.excerpt: Food now adds 55% more revenue per customer than beverages alone, and India's cafés — from work cafés to creative studios to craft brands like Subko — are building loyalty through experience, not just espresso.
food.nri_angle: The café boom mirrors third-wave coffee culture in the US and UK with a distinctly Indian accent — modern cafés are now a fixture of NRI homecoming itineraries, and the experience-led loyalty playbook is transferable to diaspora-run café ventures abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: From Rs 18 Lakh Debt to Rs 2 Crore Sales: A Chole Bhature Miracle
food.excerpt: A tiny Chembur eatery was Rs 18 lakh in debt and about to close — then Abhishek Upmanyu's Instagram tip and Anushka Sharma's order for Virat Kohli turned Delhi Se into a four-outlet, Rs 2-crore-a-month brand.
food.image_caption: Delhi Se, a 250-square-foot chole bhature outlet in Mumbai’s Chembur, now sells 3,000-plus plates a day.
food.nri_angle: The Delhi Se turnaround shows how Indian celebrity culture can transform a small business overnight — a dynamic the diaspora watches closely, since Punjabi eateries are among the most common immigrant small businesses in the US, UK and Canada.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Harsh Goenka Savours 10-Course Vegetarian Menu at World's No. 1 Restaurant Maido
food.excerpt: At Maido in Lima — No. 1 on the World's 50 Best Restaurants 2025 — chef Mitsuharu Tsumura created his first-ever 10-course vegetarian tasting menu, and Goenka called it memorable.
food.image_caption: Harsh Goenka, chairman of RPG Group, shared his meal on X on September 28, 2026. He dined at Maido in Lima, Peru, ranked No. 1 on the World's 50 Best Restaurants 2025 list.
food.nri_angle: An Indian vegetarian billionaire celebrating a plant-based tasting in Lima — a city whose Nikkei cuisine was built by the Japanese diaspora — ties two food-migration stories together.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Revant Himatsingka Quit a Rs 2 Crore US Job to Become the Food Pharmer
food.excerpt: Speaking at NDTV Yuva 2026, the food and health activist explained why 13 years in the US convinced him that India needs better health literacy around packaged food.
food.image_caption: Revant Himatsingka, known as Food Pharmer, left a Rs 2 crore consulting job in the US to raise awareness about packaged food.
food.nri_angle: Himatsingka's story mirrors a growing pattern of NRIs leaving high-paying US careers to work on problems back home — here, India's packaged-food crisis.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Inside The Oven Diner: a Kolkata café styled like a 250-year-old rajbari
travel.excerpt: At Rajkutir in Kankurgachi, pillared halls, a vintage carriage and glowing lamps recreate a Bengali zamindar mansion — and the food, per bloggers, lives up to the setting.
travel.image_caption: The Oven Diner, inside Raajkutir in Kankurgachi, recreates the grandeur of a Bengali rajbari — pillared halls, a vintage horse-drawn carriage and glowing lamps.
travel.nri_angle: Bengali diaspora visitors get a rooted, photogenic dining stop for Kolkata trips, especially around Durga Puja season.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Banswara: inside Rajasthan's 'City of 100 Islands' and its tribal heritage
travel.excerpt: About 150 km south of Udaipur, the Mahi River braids into hundreds of islets around a district rich in Bhil history, Shakti Peetha temples and monsoon waterfalls.
travel.nri_angle: For NRIs with Rajasthani roots, Banswara offers uncrowded tribal heritage and freedom-struggle history at Mangarh Dham beyond the usual Jaipur-Udaipur circuit.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Philippine Airlines Returns to India With Nonstop Manila-Delhi and Mumbai Flights
travel.excerpt: The Philippine flag carrier will fly nonstop from Manila to Delhi three times a week and Mumbai four times weekly from December 2026, pending Indian government approval — eight years after an earlier plan never took off.
travel.nri_angle: Direct Manila flights give the Philippines' Indian community its first nonstop link to India, cut journey times for diaspora travellers to Boracay and Cebu, and add a future oneworld option for Australia and North America routings via Manila.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: California Bans AI-Only Firing of Workers With Landmark No Robo Bosses Act
carousel.excerpt: Governor Gavin Newsom signed SB 947 on September 30, making California the first state to require a human to corroborate any termination or discipline decision driven primarily by AI — reversing his veto of a similar bill last year.
carousel.nri_angle: California's large Indian diaspora tech workforce gains a concrete safeguard against opaque automated firing and discipline decisions.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Manchester City Verdict Strains Britain's Diplomatic Ties With the UAE
carousel.excerpt: The UAE has warned London that sanctions against the Abu Dhabi-owned club could cool future investment, while British ministers privately question whether senior Emirati figures knew of the £900 million financial misconduct.
carousel.image_caption: Manchester City's Etihad Stadium in Manchester, with its distinctive cable-stayed roof masts visible. The Abu Dhabi-owned club was found guilty of 130 breaches of Premier League financial rules, a verdict now straining diplomatic ties between the UK and the UAE.
carousel.nri_angle: The UAE hosts one of the largest Indian communities in the world, and friction over London-Abu Dhabi investment flows matters to the diaspora in both countries.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India Clinch Sepaktakraw Bronze After Narrow Semifinal Loss to Japan
carousel.excerpt: India's men's quadrant team went down 0-2 to Japan in the sepaktakraw semifinal at Nagoya, securing the country's third Asian Games medal in the sport and its first in the quadrant event.
carousel.image_caption: Members of India's men's sepaktakraw quadrant squad pictured at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. India went down 0-2 to hosts Japan in the semifinal on October 2 to take bronze — the country's third sepaktakraw medal at the Asiad and its first in the quadrant event.
carousel.nri_angle: The bronze resonates with the Northeast Indian diaspora, whose communities champion sepaktakraw as a sport where their states lead the nation — a national podium finish validates that pride on Asia's biggest stage.

carousel.title: Adani Group Reaffirms Rs 6 Lakh Crore Investment Blueprint for Maharashtra
carousel.excerpt: Pranav Adani said projects worth Rs 2.6 lakh crore — over 43% of the blueprint — are already completed or under execution, as Maharashtra chases its $1 trillion economy target by 2030.
carousel.image_caption: Adani Enterprises director Pranav Adani, in a file photo. He announced the Adani Group's investment blueprint of over Rs 6 lakh crore for Maharashtra at the Invest Maharashtra launch in Mumbai, saying projects worth Rs 2.6 lakh crore are already completed or under execution.
carousel.nri_angle: NRI investors with Adani stock or India-fund exposure face concentrated exposure to one state's regulatory environment; global bondholders will watch whether the 43% execution pace sustains.
